metadata.title: Fractal solutions to the two-dimensional floating body problem
metadata.abstract: In this paper, the first construction of an entire class of two-dimensional fractal bodies that float in water in equilibrium is explicitly given. Their boundaries are described by planar fractal Zindler curves which are constructed using fractal projective hedgehogs. The areas of these bodies are seen to be well-defined and their expression is explicitly computed. To this end, a result concerning the continuity of the Lebesgue measure with respect to the Hausdorff metric for compact sets is given. Furthermore, the Hausdorff dimension $w$ of these fractal curves is shown to coincide with the Hausdorff dimension of the graph of a Weierstrass function associated to the corresponding fractal projective hedgehog. The fractal Zindler curves are proved to have halving chords of constant length that split both the area and the $w$-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the curve into exact halves.

analysis.workSummary: 作者显式构造一整类二维分形平衡浮体，其边界为从分形射影hedgehog得到的分形Zindler曲线。给出面积存在性与显式表达，并将边界Hausdorff维数w识别为相关Weierstrass函数图像的维数；等长二分弦同时精确平分面积和w维Hausdorff测度。
analysis.breakthrough: 把平衡浮体构造扩展到具有精确面积及弦二分性质的分形边界。
analysis.limitations: Lebesgue测度的Hausdorff连续性须有具体适用条件，不能对任意紧集推广；浮体与维数条件需正文核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文补检仅有第6页a straightforward拼成Astra的普通文字误匹配；第19页致谢仅含资助，第20页为参考文献与作者信息，未观察到作者使用AI披露。本结论仅记录未观察到披露，不推断没有使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 涉及凸与非光滑曲线几何及精确构造。
